[[Northern Shiverpeaks/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[File:Shiverpeak Mountains signpost.jpg|175px]] | pic3-text = Shiverpeak Mountains [[signpost]]. | pic4 = [[File:Shiverpeak Mountains waymarker.jpg|135px]] | pic4-text = Shiverpeak Mountains waymarker. }} The [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] are, despite the name, a central region within the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]]. Inhabited mainly by the [[Deldrimor]] and [[Stone Summit]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]], they are also occupied by [[Centaur]]s and [[Ettin]]s. They are often used as the primary route to cross the Shiverpeaks, with [[the Frost Gate (landmark)|the Frost Gate]] barring one of two passes.
